description: Focused on stabilizing experimental features, clearing BETA tags, and polishing the overall experience before expanding the feature set further.

items.desc: Stabilizing the context-aware sidebar and promoting it out of the experimental state.
Removing BETA labels from the Discover and Featured pages following performance validation.
Re-enabling and completing the 'Go To' navigation on the Changelog page.
Expanding localization coverage with additional language packs.
Replacing the hard-coded Adult Content filter with user-configurable content settings.
Quick-access theme toggle available directly from the navigation bar.
